overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（7 篇）、银行与信贷（2 篇）、房地产金融（1 篇）。方法上以贝叶斯方法、回归分析为主。来源分布：arXiv（7 篇）、OpenAlex（3 篇）、Semantic Scholar（2 篇）。

papers.title: From Prototype to Clinical Workflow: Co-Developing a Wearable Hypomimia System for Parkinson’s Disease
papers.abstract: Hypomimia, the reduced facial expressiveness commonly seen in Parkinson’s disease (PD), is clinically relevant, yet routine assessment usually relies on a single ordinal rating item in major rating scales such as the Unified Parkinson’s Disease Rating Scale (MDS-UPDRS). This study aimed to develop and iteratively refine a wearable, cap-mounted device for hypomimia recording during routine inpatient ON/OFF assessments and to examine its usability and technical feasibility. A staged co-development process with four prototypes was conducted. After clinician workflow requirements had been incorporated, Prototype 3 was evaluated during clinical routine using the System Usability Scale (SUS) and short free-text feedback. These findings informed a patient-centered redesign that resulted in Prototype 4. Bench testing confirmed stable operation, robust housing, and reliable closed Wi-Fi streaming. Usability improved from moderate in Prototype 3 (mean SUS 44.7, SD 18.2; n = 15) to good in Prototype 4 (mean SUS 80.0, SD 12.6; n = 50). Mixed-effects regression showed an increase of approximately 33 SUS points for the redesigned device (95% CI 27.7–39.4; p < 0.001). Mean effective sampling rate was 4.79 frames/s (SD 0.33), with face detection in 95.4% of frames. These feasibility and usability results indicate that technical robustness and patient-centered design are critical prerequisites for later clinical validation and support the integration of a wearable hypomimia capture device into routine assessments.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】帕金森病（PD）患者常表现为面部表情减少的现象，这种现象被称为“低面部表情性”（hypomimia）。虽然这一症状在临床上具有重要意义，但目前的常规评估方法主要依赖于统一帕金森病评分量表（Unified Parkinson’s Disease Rating Scale, MDS-UPDRS）等评估工具中的单一序数评分项。本研究旨在开发一种可穿戴式设备，用于在患者住院期间的常规“开药/停药”（ON/OFF）评估过程中记录其面部表情变化，并对其可用性和技术可行性进行评估。研究通过四代原型的逐步开发过程完成了这一目标。在结合临床医生的实际使用需求后，第三代原型通过系统可用性量表（System Usability Scale, SUS）和患者提供的简短自由文本反馈进行了评估。这些评估结果为产品的重新设计提供了依据，最终形成了第四代原型。台架测试证实该设备运行稳定，外壳坚固耐用，并且能够通过Wi-Fi稳定传输数据。第四代原型的可用性评分从第三代的“中等”（平均SUS得分44.7分，标准差18.2分，样本量15人）提升至“良好”（平均SUS得分80.0分，标准差12.6分，样本量50人）。混...。研究方法：回归分析。

papers.title: Generalization of LSTM and CNN autoencoders for anomaly detection across orthogonal and longitudinal turning
papers.venue: The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  Machine learning models enable automated process monitoring in manufacturing and support adaptive quality assurance and predictive maintenance systems. Autoencoders have emerged as a promising approach to unsupervised anomaly detection in processes. However, their application to turning processes, particularly their generalizability across different process variants such as varying machine kinematics, cutting geometries, and process variability, remains largely unexplored. Existing studies mainly focus on controlled laboratory environments using single machine tools and standardized parameters, limiting industrial scalability. This work addresses this gap by systematically comparing long short-term memory (LSTM) and convolutional (CNN) based autoencoders developed in collaboration with two research projects. The models are trained and evaluated on two harmonized datasets derived from orthogonal and longitudinal turning processes. The datasets differ with respect to machine tools, kinematics, and cutting tools. Each model is trained on both its native process data and on the respective other dataset to evaluate cross-domain performance. The results on normalized reconstruction errors show that LSTM-based autoencoders yield higher temporal sensitivity, whereas CNN-based autoencoders exhibit greater reconstruction stability but reduced sensitivity to transient dynamics. Moreover, relative reconstruction errors are additionally evaluated in the original physical force units to improve process interpretability. This analysis reveals larger relative deviations for LSTM models due to their heightened sensitivity. Furthermore, the variability of the training dataset is identified as a key factor influencing out-of-distribution generalization performance. The findings demonstrate the generalizability of autoencoder based monitoring approaches across different cutting conditions and provide insights for data-driven and grey-box modeling frameworks in manufacturing.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】摘要  
机器学习模型实现了制造业中的自动化过程监控，为自适应质量保证和预测性维护系统提供了支持。自动编码器作为一种无监督异常检测方法，在过程监控领域展现出巨大潜力。然而，将其应用于车削加工过程（尤其是考虑不同机床运动学、切削几何形状及过程变异性等因素时的泛化能力）的研究仍较为有限。现有研究主要集中在使用单一机床和标准化参数的受控实验室环境中，这限制了其在工业领域的应用范围。本研究通过系统比较两种基于长短期记忆（LSTM）和卷积神经网络（CNN）的自动编码器，填补了这一空白。这些模型是在两个经过协调处理的数据集上训练和评估的，这两个数据集分别来源于正交车削过程和纵向车削过程，它们在机床类型、运动学特性及切削工具方面存在差异。每个模型均在其原始数据集以及另一个数据集上进行训练，以评估其跨领域性能。标准化重建误差的测试结果表明，基于LSTM的自动编码器具有更高的时间敏感性，而基于CNN的自动编码器则具有更稳定的重建效果，但对瞬态动态变化的响应能力较弱。为提高过程数据的可解释性，还进一步以原始物理力单位对相对重建误差进行了评估。分析发现，由于LSTM模型具有更高的敏感性，其相对误差较大...。研究方法：机器学习。

papers.title: Shared Bidding Algorithms and Competition: Evidence from Electricity Markets
papers.abstract: Competing firms increasingly delegate pricing and bidding decisions to algorithms supplied by the same third-party providers. We study whether a shared algorithm leads competitors to internalise one another's profits, using data from the Australian National Electricity Market, where every battery's bids are observed at 5-minute frequency and can be linked to an identifiable autobidding provider. Bids constructed by the same provider co-move, and do so more strongly after a disclosure reform made the common scarcity state easier to observe: the same information that steers batteries towards efficient arbitrage also synchronises the bids of competitors who share a provider. To separate co-movement due to shared information from joint profit maximisation, we estimate each battery's dynamic value of stored energy and reclear the market under counterfactual bids. Owner-level profits cannot rationalise observed bidding: batteries forgo profitable dispatch where it would depress the prices earned by same-provider batteries owned by rival firms, and the estimated weight on those rivals' profits is close to one. We find evidence of this conduct only where a provider's share of near-margin battery capacity exceeds roughly 30%, corresponding to an installed share of roughly 20%. The identified conduct costs consumers an annualised $5.5 million on the current fleet, and it arises at the level of the algorithm provider rather than the asset owner, a layer that ownership-based concentration screens do not capture.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】越来越多的竞争企业将定价和出价决策委托给同一第三方提供商提供的算法。我们利用澳大利亚国家电力市场的数据进行了研究，该市场中的每块电池的出价信息以5分钟为间隔进行记录，并且可以追溯到具体的自动出价提供商。由同一提供商生成的出价之间存在协同变动现象；在实施了一项信息披露改革后（该改革使得电池的共同稀缺状态更易于被观察到），这种协同变动现象变得更加明显：促使电池进行高效套利的同一信息，也同步了使用同一提供商服务的竞争对手的出价行为。为了区分这种由信息共享导致的协同变动与共同利润最大化行为，我们估算了每块电池储存能量的动态价值，并在假设其他出价情况不变的情况下重新模拟了市场交易过程。从实际观察到的出价行为来看，电池所有者无法合理解释这种行为：它们会在某些情况下放弃盈利的发电机会，因为这会压低竞争对手旗下使用同一提供商服务的电池所获得的利润；而且我们对竞争对手利润影响的估计值接近1。我们仅在某个提供商所拥有的接近盈亏平衡点的电池容量占比超过30%（相当于其装机容量占比约为20%）的情况下，发现了这种行为的证据。这种行为每年给消费者造成的损失约为550万美元，且这一成本主要由算法提供商承担，...。

papers.title: A Noise-Aware Quantum Algorithm for Credit Valuation Adjustments on Real Quantum Hardware
papers.abstract: Credit Valuation Adjustment (CVA) requires repeated risk-neutral expectation estimation, making it a natural test bed for quantum amplitude estimation, whose coherent amplification can in principle reduce Monte Carlo sampling cost. Whether this advantage survives realistic financial encoding and noisy hardware remains open. We develop an end-to-end, noise-aware quantum workflow for CVA, covering market calibration, discretisation, oracle construction, hardware execution and error-budget analysis. The model combines a correlated two-asset exposure with discount and default factors, encoded through a QCBM-based joint time-market distribution and controlled payoff rotations. We introduce contrast-aware Bayesian iterative quantum amplitude estimation (CABIQAE), which incorporates experimentally calibrated Grover-contrast loss into Bayesian inference and circuit-depth selection. Hardware-calibrated experiments show that CABIQAE exploits the limited amplification available on current devices more effectively than noise-agnostic alternatives and achieves a much lower classical post-processing runtime than the noise-aware BAE baseline. The analysis further decomposes the total CVA error into statistical, encoding, discretisation and hardware contributions. The full CVA oracle remains limited by circuit depth and discretisation resolution.
papers.summary_zh: 【银行与信贷】信用估值调整（Credit Valuation Adjustment，CVA）需要反复进行风险中性预期估计，这使其成为量子振幅估计（quantum amplitude estimation）的理想测试平台。量子振幅估计的相干放大原理上可以降低蒙特卡洛（Monte Carlo）采样成本。然而，在实际金融编码和噪声硬件环境下，这种优势是否依然存在，目前尚无定论。我们开发了一套端到端的、考虑噪声影响的量子工作流程，用于CVA的计算，涵盖市场校准、离散化处理、预言机（oracle）构建、硬件执行以及误差预算分析等环节。该模型将相关资产组合的敞口与折现和违约因素结合起来，通过基于量子置信界限模型（QCBM）的联合时间-市场分布（joint time-market distribution）进行编码，并通过特定的支付旋转机制（controlled payoff rotations）来实现计算。我们提出了基于对比度意识的贝叶斯迭代量子振幅估计方法（Contrast-Aware Bayesian Iterative Quantum Amplitude Estimation，CABIQAE），该方...。研究方法：贝叶斯方法、蒙特卡洛模拟、模型校准、实验方法。

papers.title: CORPORATE GOVERNANCE IN THE ARMENIAN BANKING SYSTEM: TRENDS, CHALLENGES, AND PERSPECTIVES
papers.abstract: The research presents the results of systematic empirical research on the current state, emerging trends, and challenges of the corporate governance system in commercial banks of the Republic of Armenia. The research demonstrates that the Armenian banking system is dominated by a "regulator-owner" model, where corporate governance is primarily viewed as a tool for regulatory compliance and risk management rather than a mechanism for strategic value creation. The study identifies structural gaps, including high ownership concentration, the dominance of the executive body, and the limited institutional role of the board of directors. Furthermore, the findings indicate that despite growing interest in ESG principles and digitalization, their implementation remains largely driven by external requirements and is hindered by a lack of localized methodologies and professional capabilities. The results suggest that the Armenian banking system is in a transitional phase, shifting from a regulatory-compliance model toward a more strategic, digitalized, and sustainable governance system.
papers.summary_zh: 【银行与信贷】本研究系统地探讨了亚美尼亚共和国商业银行公司治理体系的现状、新兴趋势及面临的挑战。研究发现，亚美尼亚银行业主要采用“监管者-所有者”模式，其中公司治理更多地被视为一种合规监管和风险管理的工具，而非创造战略价值的机制。研究指出了该体系存在的结构性问题，如股权高度集中、管理层权力过大以及董事会的制度作用有限。此外，尽管人们对环境、社会和治理（ESG）原则及数字化转型的关注度日益提高，但这些实践的推行仍主要受外部要求的驱动，并受到缺乏本土化方法论和专业能力的制约。研究结果表明，亚美尼亚银行业正处于转型阶段，正从以合规监管为导向的治理模式向更具战略性、数字化和可持续性的治理体系转变。。

papers.title: REAL ESTATE PRICE INDICES AS A TOOL FOR ASSESSING MARKET STABILITY AND DETECTING FINANCIAL BUBBLES
papers.abstract: This article tests and evaluates the presence of financial bubbles in the real estate market of the Republic of Armenia (hereinafter RA), based on time series analysis and the application of ADF, SADF, and GSADF tests, as well as the multi-dimensional Net Present Value (NPV) and Static Borrowing Capacity (hereinafter SBC) models. The research investigates deviations of housing market prices from their fundamental values during the period of 2012–2024. The obtained results provide insights into whether there are signs of overvaluation in the market.
papers.summary_zh: 【房地产金融】本文通过时间序列分析以及ADF（Augmented Dickey-Fuller）、SADF（Stationary Dickey-Fuller）和GSADF（Generalized Dickey-Fuller）检验方法，结合多维度净现值（NPV）模型和静态借贷能力（SBC）模型，对亚美尼亚共和国（以下简称RA）房地产市场中是否存在金融泡沫进行了检测与评估。研究重点考察了2012年至2024年期间房价与其内在价值之间的偏离情况。研究结果有助于判断该市场是否存在估值过高的迹象。。研究方法：时间序列。

papers.title: TEM-4 Vocabulary Learning Needs of Chinese PGUI Students: A Mixed-Methods Analysis for Mobile App Design
papers.abstract: Private general undergraduate institutions (PGUIs) account for 31.5% of undergraduate institutions in China, yet the vocabulary learning needs of their English majors remain underexplored, highlighting a critical research gap. This study adopts Hutchinson and Waters’ (1987) needs analysis framework to examine PGUI students’ Test for English Majors Band-4 (TEM-4) vocabulary learning needs. Employing a convergent parallel mixed-methods design, this study integrated questionnaire data from 240 students with semi-structured interviews from seven experienced teachers. The findings indicated that 77.9% of students recognized vocabulary as essential for TEM-4 performance, reflected in a high mean score for perceived necessity (M = 3.98, SD = 1.05). However, they reported moderate perceived lacks (M = 3.62) in current learning approaches. Students showed strong acceptance of mobile-assisted learning (M = 3.80) and high expectations for deep learning functions (M = 3.71). Qualitative analysis of 475 codes across 26 sub-themes revealed that teachers identified a critical 3:1 receptive-productive gap, with students recognizing approximately 6,000 words but actively using fewer than 2,000. All seven teachers confirmed that existing mobile applications, despite widespread use, fail to support deep vocabulary learning outcomes. The integration of quantitative and qualitative findings provided clear guidelines for developing TEM-4-specific mobile applications, highlighting systematic testing with immediate feedback, authentic TEM-4 examples, vocabulary discrimination exercises, and multimodal learning resources. The study provides empirical evidence for designing mobile applications that address the multidimensional vocabulary learning needs of PGUI students, a distinct and under-researched learner population.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】私立普通本科院校（PGUIs）占中国本科院校总数的31.5%，然而这些院校英语专业学生的词汇学习需求尚未得到充分研究，这凸显出一个重要的研究空白。本研究采用Hutchinson和Waters（1987）提出的需求分析框架，来探讨PGUI学生的英语专业四级（TEM-4）词汇学习需求。通过混合方法设计（定量与定性相结合），本研究收集了240名学生的问卷数据，并对7位经验丰富的教师进行了半结构化访谈。调查结果显示，77.9%的学生认为词汇对TEM-4考试表现至关重要（平均得分3.98分，标准差1.05分）；但他们同时指出当前的学习方法存在一定的不足（平均得分3.62分）。学生们普遍认可移动辅助学习方式（平均得分3.80分），并对深度学习功能抱有较高期望（平均得分3.71分）。通过对26个子主题下的475条反馈内容的定性分析，研究发现师生之间存在明显的“接受性词汇”与“产出性词汇”之间的差距：学生能够识别约6000个词汇，但实际上主动使用的词汇数量不足2000个。所有7位教师均认为，尽管现有移动应用程序被广泛使用，但它们仍无法有效支持学生的深度词汇学习。定量与定性研究结果的结合为开发针对...。研究方法：深度学习。

papers.title: Bivariate Isotonic Regression by Dynamic Programming
papers.abstract: This article extends the dynamic programming framework introduced by (Rote, 2019) from the univariate to the bivariate isotonic problem, using an anti-diagonal traversal procedure. The proposed algorithm is applied to the well-known baseball data set that describes the association of salary with a collection of player properties, including the number of runs batted and hits. The new algorithm is relevant in the sense that dynamic programming has a wide range of applications in economics, such as the savings problem, economic growth, job search, business cycles, oligopoly equilibrium, recursive contracts, and forecasting.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】本文将(Rote, 2019)提出的动态规划框架从单变量问题扩展到双变量等值问题，并采用了一种逆对角线遍历方法。所提出的算法被应用于著名的棒球数据集，该数据集描述了球员薪资与其多种属性（包括击球得分和安打次数）之间的关系。这一新算法具有重要意义，因为动态规划在经济学领域有着广泛的应用，例如储蓄问题、经济增长、求职行为、经济周期分析、寡头市场均衡、递归契约以及预测分析等。。研究方法：均衡模型。

papers.title: Orthogonal Integrated Conditional Moment Tests for Treatment Effect Heterogeneity
papers.abstract: We propose a nonparametric integrated conditional moment (ICM) test for treatment effect heterogeneity across subpopulations defined by a given covariate subvector. Under unconfoundedness, the null is recast as a conditional moment restriction based on a Neyman-orthogonal score, which reduces the first-order sensitivity of the empirical process to nuisance parameter estimation. The test statistics are constructed as continuous functionals of a marked empirical process. We establish a uniform feasible-to-oracle approximation and derive the asymptotic properties of these test statistics under the null and fixed alternatives. We further show that the test has nontrivial power against local alternatives converging to the null at the $n^{-1/2}$ rate, and develop an easy-to-implement multiplier bootstrap for feasible inference. We also develop extensions to tests of parametric CATE specifications and to settings with endogenous treatment and a binary instrument. Finally, we apply the proposed testing approach to study whether the effect of maternal smoking during pregnancy on infant birth weight varies with maternal age.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们提出了一种非参数的集成条件矩（ICM）检验方法，用于检测由特定协变量子向量定义的亚群体之间的治疗效果异质性。在无混杂因素的情况下，原假设被重新表述为基于Neyman-正交得分的条件矩约束，这降低了经验过程对干扰参数估计的一阶敏感性。检验统计量被构建为标记经验过程的连续函数。我们建立了统一的、可实现与“完美答案”（oracle）近似的方法，并推导了在原假设和固定备择假设下这些检验统计量的渐近性质。进一步研究表明，该检验对收敛到原假设的局部备择假设具有非平凡的功效，其功效收敛速度为$n^{-1/2}$；同时，我们还开发了一种易于实施的乘数自助法（multiplier bootstrap）来进行可行的推断。此外，我们还对该检验方法进行了扩展，以适用于参数化条件平均处理效应（parametric CATE）规格的检验，以及存在内生处理变量和二元工具变量的情况。最后，我们应用所提出的检验方法研究了孕期母亲吸烟对婴儿出生体重的影响是否随母亲年龄的不同而变化。。

papers.title: The Limits of Price Discrimination with a Bayesian Seller
papers.abstract: We study the limits of third-degree price discrimination when the production cost is Bayesian and private to the seller, generalizing the seminal work of Bergemann, Brooks and Morris (2015). The rough setup is the following: A monopoly seller sets different prices for buyers in different "segments" of the market so as to maximize seller surplus. Different ways in which the aggregate market is decomposed into segments lead to different welfare outcomes, i.e., (seller surplus, buyer surplus) pairs. When the production cost is Bayesian, the region of achievable welfare outcomes can exhibit complex shapes beyond the clean characterization by Bergemann, Brooks and Morris for the case with a fixed cost. We show that with a Bayesian cost, this region coincides with a proper projection of a polytope defined by a polynomial number of linear constraints, the essential ones of which correspond to flow conservation in a "discounted" flow network. As a result, we give a polynomial-time algorithm that computes optimal market segmentations in terms of any linear combination of the seller surplus and the buyer surplus. En route, we establish the following structural property: Any market can be written as a convex combination of "extremal markets" in a way preserving the seller surplus and the buyer surplus. These extremal markets are piecewise equal-surplus with respect to different possible costs, generalizing a similar notion introduced by Bergemann, Brooks and Morris when the cost is fixed.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们研究了当生产成本具有贝叶斯性质且为卖方所独有时，三级价格歧视的极限情况，从而扩展了Bergemann、Brooks和Morris（2015年）的开创性研究。研究的基本框架如下：垄断卖方针对市场中的不同“细分市场”设定不同的价格，以最大化卖方利润。将整体市场划分为不同细分市场的方式会影响福利结果（即卖方利润与买方利润的组合）。当生产成本具有贝叶斯性质时，可实现福利结果的区域可能呈现出复杂的形态，超出了Bergemann、Brooks和Morris在固定成本情况下所描述的简单模型。我们证明了，在这种成本结构下，该福利结果区域与由多项式数量线性约束定义的多面体的投影相吻合，其中关键的线性约束对应于“折现”流网络中的流量守恒规律。因此，我们提出了一种多项式时间算法，能够根据卖方利润和买方利润的任意线性组合来确定最优的市场细分方案。在此过程中，我们还发现了一个重要的结构特性：任何市场都可以表示为“极端市场”的凸组合，且这种表示方式能够保持卖方利润和买方利润的原始值不变。这些极端市场在不同成本条件下具有分段相等利润的特性，这一结论扩展了Bergemann、Brooks和Morris在固定...。研究方法：贝叶斯方法。

papers.title: Interpreting (and testing) factor loadings
papers.abstract: Dynamic Factor Models (DFMs) are popular to reduce dimensionality being customary in the empirical analysis of large systems of macroeconomic and/or financial variables. In this context, the common underlying factors and their loadings are often extracted using Principal Components (PC), which are consistent and asymptotically normal under very general conditions. Consequently, inference on the factor loadings, which is crucial for the correct interpretation of the underlying factors, is often based on their asymptotic distribution with the limit covariance matrix of the loadings consistently estimated using HAC estimators. In this paper, we analyse the performance of the finite sample asymptotic approximation when constructing confidence intervals and testing about estimated PC loadings. We show that this approximation is seriously affected when the cross-sectional dimension is not large enough. We propose using HAR inference and a subsampling procedure to correct the MSE of the loadings to take into account the uncertainty associated with the estimation of the covariance matrix and of the factors, respectively. The relevance of the results is illustrated in an empirical analysis of economic convergence among the US states.
papers.summary_zh: 【资产定价】动态因子模型（Dynamic Factor Models, DFM）因其能够有效降低数据维度而在对宏观经济和/或金融变量的大型系统的实证分析中得到广泛应用。在这些分析中，通常使用主成分分析（Principal Component Analysis, PCA）来提取潜在的共同因子及其载荷值。PCA在非常一般的条件下具有稳定性，并且其结果呈渐近正态分布。因此，对因子载荷值的推断——这对于正确理解潜在因子至关重要——往往基于这些载荷值的渐近分布，而载荷值的极限协方差矩阵则是通过HAC（High-Accuracy Covariance Estimation）方法来估计的。在本文中，我们研究了在构建置信区间和对估计的主成分载荷值进行检验时，有限样本渐近近似的性能。我们发现，当横截面维度不足时，这种近似方法的准确性会受到严重影响。为此，我们提出采用HAR（Heteroscedasticity-Armed Regression）推断方法和子样本技术来修正载荷值的均方误差（MSE），以充分考虑协方差矩阵和因子估计过程中所存在的不确定性。通过对比分析美国各州之间的经济收敛情况，我们验证了这些方法的...。研究方法：横截面分析、主成分分析、因子模型。

papers.title: Ito-Wentzell Formula and Dupire Stochastic PDE
papers.abstract: Starting from the classic result of Wentzell, we derive a conditional forward equation and an associated stochastic Dupire PDE for a local-stochastic-volatility model (LSV). As an application, we obtain a density-weighted Rao--Blackwell estimator for the leverage function in LSV. We also derive an SPDE for a rolling expiry vanilla option, in the spirit of the Musiela parametrization in interest rate modeling.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】基于Wentzell的经典研究成果，我们推导出了一个条件前向方程以及一个与之相关的随机Dupire偏微分方程（SPDE），用于描述局部随机波动性模型（Local-Stochastic-Volatility, LSV）。作为应用实例，我们得到了一个基于密度加权的Rao-Blackwell估计量，用于估计LSV模型中的杠杆函数。此外，我们还推导出了一个适用于滚动到期普通期权的随机偏微分方程（SPDE），其建模思路借鉴了Musiela在利率建模中的参数化方法。。研究方法：随机过程。
